help.interactionNone: Neither Unit Can Attack the Other
help.guideIntro: War Nexus is a military strategy game. Build your base, create your army, research technologies and defeat your rivals. Here are your first steps:
help.guideStep1Desc: Headquarters is the foundation of all buildings and capacities. As it levels up, you can produce stronger units and store more. Always prioritize upgrading HQ.
help.guideStep2Desc: Oil Field, Mine, and Houses produce resources continuously. Bank earns interest on your cash. Upgrading these buildings is crucial in the long run.
help.guideStep3Desc: Start producing infantry units from Barracks. Unit training requires resources and time. Each building has its own unit capacity — tied to HQ level.
help.guideStep4Desc: Unlock new technologies and units from Research Lab. Each completed research gives +12% attack bonus.
help.guideStep5Desc: Create squads from HQ > Operations tab. You can add different unit types to a squad. You go to battle with squads.
help.guideStep6Desc: View your rivals from Rankings and attack. You can attack players within ±5 of your rank. Win to earn resources and power.
help.guideStep7Desc: Complete 50 different missions from the Missions tab. Each mission rewards resources and gold. Missions guide you in the right direction.
help.economyTip1: • Upgrade Bank level — each level increases interest rate (+0.4%/hr/level)
help.economyTip2: • Upgrade resource buildings — each level increases hourly production
help.economyTip3: • Use Bank exchange with gold for emergency resource needs
help.economyTip4: • Win battles to take 20% of your rival's resources
help.combatRule1Desc: Each unit branch has advantages/disadvantages against others. For example, infantry is weak against tanks, air defense is strong against aircraft. Check the Cross Table section for details.
help.combatRule2Desc: Both sides lose units equal to the opponent's unit count. The winner's advantage: resource and power transfer goes to the winner.
help.combatRule3Desc: After battle, 20% of the loser's resources and power are transferred to the winner.
help.combatRule4Desc: A defending player who loses gets a 4-hour protection shield — they cannot be attacked during this time.
help.combatRule5Desc: warPower increases when you win and decreases when you lose. warPower cannot exceed your base power (buildings+units+research) — maximum 2x multiplier.
help.combatRule6Desc: Total power = Building Power + Unit Power + Research Power + warPower (capped). This value is used for rankings.
help.pvpRule1Desc: All players are ranked by Player Power. Top 100 is shown. If you're below 100, you also see your region (±10).
help.pvpRule2Desc: You can only attack players 5 above and 5 below your rank. Those outside the range are shown faded.
help.pvpRule3Desc: If you attack a player and WIN, you cannot attack the same player for 4 hours. If you lose, you can attack again immediately.
help.pvpRule4Desc: If you defeat an attacker in defense, you earn revenge rights against that player. Revenge attack bypasses the ±5 rule. If you win revenge too, 4-hour cooldown starts.
help.pvpRule5Desc:
1) Choose rival from Rankings
2) Select squad (pre-created)
3) Press ATTACK button
4) March timer expires
5) Battle auto-resolves
6) Result report shown
help.pvpRule6Desc: Each player has a unique coordinate in X.Y.Z format. Coordinates determine map position.
help.squadRule1Desc: A squad is a military group you send to battle. It can consist of different unit types. You go to battle with squads — you cannot send units directly.
help.squadRule2Desc: Press "Create Squad" from HQ > Operations tab. Name your squad and add from your available units.
help.squadRule3Desc: Add units with ±1, ±10, ±100 buttons or by typing a number. You cannot add more than your available count.
help.squadRule4Desc: You can create up to 5 squads at once. Each squad can have any number of units (limited by your inventory).
help.squadRule5Desc: When attacking from Rankings, choose which squads to send. You can select multiple squads. All selected squads' units are combined to calculate attack power.
help.squadRule6Desc: If you win, units stay in the squad. If you lose, the squad and all its units are destroyed.
help.bankInterestDesc: Bank earns hourly interest on your current cash. Each level increases interest rate by +0.4%/hr. For example, Lv.10 Bank = 4%/hr interest.
help.bankExchangeDesc: You can buy resources by spending gold from the Bank building's "Exchange" tab.
help.bankBonusDesc: Rates improve as Bank level increases (+10% per level). At Lv.10, 100% bonus — meaning 1 gold = 1,000 cash!
help.bankSpeedDesc: You can instantly complete building upgrades, research and unit training by spending gold. Cost varies by time/level.
help.questSystemDesc: There are 50 different missions in the game. First 10 are open from the start, each completed mission unlocks the next. Missions include objectives like building upgrades, unit training, research, and winning battles.
help.questRewardsDesc: Each mission gives cash, oil and ore rewards. Some milestone missions also give gold (50 gold total).
help.earlyTip1: • Upgrade HQ as fast as possible
help.earlyTip2: • Invest in resource buildings — increases long-term income
help.earlyTip3: • Produce Tier 1 units and complete missions
help.earlyTip4: • Spend gold carefully — it's the most valuable resource
help.midTip1: • Research bonuses make a big difference — advance in every branch
help.midTip2: • Switch to Tier 2 units — best power/cost ratio
help.midTip3: • Create multiple squads — try different compositions
help.midTip4: • Upgrade Defense Tower — reduces losses by 4%/level
help.lateTip1: • Produce Tier 3 units — strongest but most expensive
help.lateTip2: • Learn the cross table — right unit combination wins battles
help.lateTip3: • Climb PvP rankings — each battle earns warPower
help.lateTip4: • Use Bank exchange — get emergency resources with gold
help.generalTip1: • Only 1 building can be upgraded at a time — plan the order well
help.generalTip2: • Diverse unit composition is stronger than a single-type army
help.generalTip3: • Check your rival's power and win chance before attacking
help.generalTip4: • You can attack again immediately after losing a battle
help.generalTip5: • Use your revenge rights — surprise attack the rival who beat you
help.awRule1Desc: The alliance leader or officer can declare war on a rival alliance from the alliance menu. Wars last 24 hours.
help.awRule2Desc: During the war, members of both alliances attack each other. Each victory earns points for your alliance. The alliance with the higher total score at the end wins.
help.awRule3Desc: All alliance members are automatically enlisted in the war. You can attack enemy alliance members.
help.awRule4Desc: Protection shields cannot be purchased during an alliance war. Existing shields remain valid.
help.awRule5Desc: All members of the winning alliance receive resource and gold rewards. The losing alliance also receives a participation reward.
help.awRule6Desc: After an alliance war ends, no new war can be declared for 24 hours.
help.awTip1: • Make sure all members finish unit production before war starts
help.awTip2: • Direct strong members against weak opponents — easy points
help.awTip3: • Prepare multiple squads — you'll need reserves after losses
help.awTip5: • Coordinate attacks — apply pressure on multiple fronts simultaneously
help.awTip6: • Push to close the score gap in the final hours — rivals may get complacent
